types.definition: A stated or inferable deficiency in current materials/knowledge that the work sets out to remedy
types.why_not_existing: HYP is flat; gap vs explicit testable hypothesis lead to different checks (gap → is it closed? hypothesis → is it confirmed/refuted?). Sibling HYP/hypothesis expected from other papers.

types.definition: A specific earlier experimental finding (own or others') used as a comparator or premise
types.why_not_existing: Distinct from KNW/governing_equation: a prior result is contrasted against, an equation is computed with.

types.definition: A known structural model of the host/reference material, usually shown as a schematic, used as premise for design
types.why_not_existing: Not an OBS (not measured in this work) and not STR (not inferred here). Recurs whenever a crystal/molecular model figure opens a paper.

types.definition: A physical/empirical relation used to compute a derived quantity or to argue a proportionality
types.why_not_existing: Equations enable the 'derives' step; distinguishing them from literature facts tells a reader which OBS are computed, not measured.

types.definition: A tabulated fact about a constituent (ionic radius, composition, melting point) brought in as premise
types.why_not_existing: Different inferential role from equations (no computation) and prior results (no comparison).

types.definition: Standard spectral/diffraction assignment tables or reference patterns used to read a signal
types.why_not_existing: Needed as premise for every peak-based OBS; separating it lets us see which observations depend on look-up rather than fitting.

types.definition: Design choice to replace a constituent on a specific site/position (dopant, co-monomer, ligand) to tune a property
types.why_not_existing: DES is flat; substitution vs feedstock choice vs architecture drive different verification steps (site/valence checks follow substitution).

types.definition: Choice of starting material/precursor for a stated reason (cost, sustainability, availability, reactivity)
types.why_not_existing: Differs from substitution: no host site; verification is of conversion, not of incorporation.

types.definition: Choice of process route or auxiliary (solvent, catalyst, atmosphere) justified against a baseline
types.why_not_existing: Route choices are compared against a baseline route (xylene) rather than a structural target.

types.definition: Definition of the controlled variable and its levels that form the comparison axis for the whole paper
types.why_not_existing: Nearly every paper has it; it determines which mm_op (rank across series) applies to all OBS. Not a PRC act itself.

types.definition: A design decision made from screening results (best candidate chosen after observation)
types.why_not_existing: Captures a feedback edge OBS→DES that the forward spine lacks; not PRF because it records a choice, not a performance claim.

types.definition: Densification of powders into bulk (sintering, hot pressing, SPS)
types.why_not_existing: PRC flat. consolidation / synthesis / deposition are the three families so far; each yields different STR checks (density/texture, chemistry, film quality).

types.definition: A chemical reaction step creating a new compound/phase/polymer
types.why_not_existing: see PRC/consolidation

types.definition: Applying material onto a substrate as film/coating
types.why_not_existing: see PRC/consolidation

types.definition: A measured pattern/spectrum is judged to coincide with a reference (standard compound, undoped parent, database)
types.why_not_existing: Technique-agnostic (XRD, XPS, IR, Raman). Inference follows: identity retained / valence established. Differs from peak_shift (a change) and peak_presence (a single feature).

types.definition: Systematic displacement of a signal feature position across a series
types.why_not_existing: Same inference (lattice/bond environment change) whether XRD, XPS, Raman or IR; direction goes in attrs.

types.definition: Appearance or disappearance of a signal feature between stages or samples
types.why_not_existing: Inference is qualitative (group formed/consumed, phase appears), not metric like shift.

types.definition: Mapping of each signal feature onto sites of a proposed structure
types.why_not_existing: Leads to a structure-confirmation claim rather than a change claim.

types.definition: A measured property varies (monotonic or not) with the design variable
types.why_not_existing: The workhorse; direction/monotonicity in attrs.

types.definition: A fitted functional form/exponent of a response vs an independent variable (T, field, time)
types.why_not_existing: The inference is mechanism-by-exponent (scattering regime, diffusion law), not ranking.

types.definition: A quantity computed from other measured quantities via a governing equation (m*, PF, κl, ZT)
types.why_not_existing: Its evidential weight depends on inputs + equation; must be tracked separately from direct readouts.

types.definition: A total response shown alongside its separated contributions
types.why_not_existing: Supports a 'dominant term' claim; distinct inference from a plain trend.

types.definition: Positions of thermal/transformational events (onset, steps, Tg, peaks) on a scan
types.why_not_existing: Supports stability/transition claims and feature attribution; not a series trend per se.

types.definition: Readouts from standardised qualification tests (hardness, adhesion, gloss, rating/pass)
types.why_not_existing: Often table/text only; leads to PRF qualification not to PRP.

types.definition: Direct visual assessment of a sample (uniformity, defects, colour, gloss) from a photograph
types.why_not_existing: Neither micrograph nor quantitative; inference is qualitative ranking/selection.

types.definition: Which phase/crystal structure is present; includes 'no secondary phase'
types.why_not_existing: As in the seed example; phase fraction is a separate sibling.

types.definition: Change in unit-cell dimension or interlayer spacing
types.why_not_existing: Leads to substitution/strain inference, distinct from phase identity.

types.definition: Substitutional/interstitial/vacancy species with site and charge state
types.why_not_existing: Drives defect-chemistry mechanisms (carriers, scattering).

types.definition: Planar/line defects (stacking faults, dislocations, twin boundaries) and their density
types.why_not_existing: Drives phonon/mechanical mechanisms rather than carrier ones.

types.definition: A functional group/bond is transformed into another by a reaction step
types.why_not_existing: Molecular-scale STR; the polymer/organic analogue of phase identity change.

types.definition: A full molecular/repeat-unit structure is asserted as confirmed
types.why_not_existing: Sum-claim of several group conversions + assignments.

types.definition: Microscopic transport descriptor (carrier density, mobility, effective mass, scattering time)
types.why_not_existing: Distinct from bulk coefficients because it sits between STR and measured transport as intermediate cause.

types.definition: Claim that a property total is dominated by one of its contributions
types.why_not_existing: Enables tradeoff reasoning.

types.definition: Resistance to decomposition/mass loss with temperature
types.why_not_existing: PRP flat; property families needed at level 2.

types.definition: Glass transition, melting, or other transformation temperatures
types.why_not_existing: Different from stability: reversible transition vs irreversible degradation.

types.definition: A composite performance metric combining properties (ZT, energy density, FOM)
types.why_not_existing: Composite: always reachable via a tradeoff MEC.

types.definition: Performance judged against application test criteria
types.why_not_existing: Coating/device qualification vs intrinsic FOM.

types.definition: Claim that a new material/route performs at least as well as an incumbent baseline
types.why_not_existing: 'Drop-in replacement' claims are common in green/cost-motivated papers; the inference is equivalence, not improvement.

types.definition: Defect species/charge alter carrier or ionic populations
types.why_not_existing: MEC flat.

types.definition: Change in scattering of carriers/phonons explains a transport change
types.why_not_existing: MEC flat; recurs in thermal/electrical/ionic transport.

types.definition: Band structure/DOS feature explains a property
types.why_not_existing: MEC flat.

types.definition: Net outcome explained by one contribution outweighing an opposing one
types.why_not_existing: Very general (strength-ductility, PF-κ, capacity-rate).

types.definition: A property difference attributed to a compositional difference in the feedstock/formulation without a detailed pathway
types.why_not_existing: Weak MEC common in polymer/bio-based papers; flagging it separates explained from merely attributed differences.

types.definition: An observed feature (DTG step, peak) is attributed to a structural origin or process
types.why_not_existing: Unsure: might be OBS/signal/peak_assignment generalised. See comments.

types.definition: Summary claim of what was shown and its novelty
types.why_not_existing: DSC flat.

types.definition: Proposed use or deployment of the material
types.why_not_existing: DSC flat.

rels.name: derives
rels.definition: Measured quantities (with a KNW/governing_equation as premise_for) are combined arithmetically to yield a derived OBS
rels.why_not_existing: 'evidences' implies support of a claim; here there is no interpretation, only computation; losing this hides that m*, PF, κl, ZT are not independent evidence

rels.name: counteracts
rels.definition: A claim/effect opposes another's contribution to a common outcome (loss term in a tradeoff)
rels.why_not_existing: 'contrasts' is a comparison with a control, 'causes' is positive; tradeoff nets need a negative-sign edge

mm_ops.name: match_pattern_to_reference
mm_ops.definition: Overlay/compare a measured pattern or spectrum with a reference trace (parent, standard) and judge coincidence of features

mm_ops.name: track_peak_shift_across_series
mm_ops.definition: Follow a feature's position across stacked traces of a sample series and read its direction/magnitude

mm_ops.name: track_peak_across_stages
mm_ops.definition: Follow presence/absence of marked features across traces ordered by synthesis stage

mm_ops.name: assign_peaks_to_structure_sites
mm_ops.definition: Link labelled signals to lettered sites on a drawn structure

mm_ops.name: rank_curves_across_series
mm_ops.definition: Read the vertical ordering of overlaid curves (one per sample) versus the series variable, incl. crossings

mm_ops.name: extract_scaling_exponent
mm_ops.definition: Read a slope on log–log axes / annotated power-law fit to classify a regime

mm_ops.name: compare_against_literature_points
mm_ops.definition: Position this work's data relative to prior-work points plotted on the same axes

mm_ops.name: partition_total_into_components
mm_ops.definition: Read a total and its components on shared axes to identify the dominant contribution

mm_ops.name: read_value_at_condition
mm_ops.definition: Read ordinate values at a specific abscissa condition (e.g. max T) and compare

mm_ops.name: segment_steps_via_derivative
mm_ops.definition: Use derivative-curve extrema to split a cumulative curve into discrete steps/events

mm_ops.name: locate_transition_step
mm_ops.definition: Locate a baseline step or inflection (Tg-like) in a scan

mm_ops.name: inspect_visual_uniformity
mm_ops.definition: Judge uniformity/defects/colour of samples in a photograph and rank them

mm_ops.name: compare_panels_across_conditions
mm_ops.definition: Compare side-by-side panels/images differing in one condition

comments: Emerging hierarchy: OBS should be split by WHAT FEATURE OF THE DATA IS READ, not by technique: OBS/signal/* (peak-level readouts: shift, presence, assignment, reference_match) vs OBS/response/* (property-vs-variable readouts: trend, functional_dependence, derived_quantity, component_partition, event_temperatures) vs OBS/appearance/* (images judged qualitatively). Technique goes in attrs; this made XRD, XPS, FTIR and NMR share four leaves across a ceramic and a polymer paper. STR splits by scale/kind (phase, lattice, defect, chemical); KNW splits by how the premise is used (equation to compute, prior result to compare, fact, reference assignment, structure model). DES/series/variable_sweep is proposed because every OBS/response edge implicitly compares along it. DES/down_select + the OBS→DES edge shows the spine is not purely forward. The rel 'derives' matters for multimodal honesty: several 'figures' (m*, PF, κl, ZT) are computed from other figures and are not independent evidence; in paper 1 this exposed an internal arithmetic inconsistency (F7a vs F7b, x=0.1). Consider an mm_op cross_check_figures for the judge's own audit, not for paper graphs. Unsure: (1) MEC/feature_attribution vs OBS/signal/peak_assignment — attributing a DTG step to urethane cleavage is the same act as assigning a peak; I lean to merge into a general OBS/signal/feature_assignment. (2) PRP/carrier_parameter may be too physics-specific; alternative PRP/intermediate_descriptor. (3) OBS/response/event_temperatures vs locate_transition_step overlap (type vs op) — acceptable. (4) PRF/baseline_equivalence could be an attr (outcome=equivalent) on a PRF + contrasts edge; I keep it because the equivalence claim triggers different follow-ups (cost/sustainability discussion) than improvement. (5) PRC level-2 families are thin from two papers.
